narration.text: A lighting maker's freight claims filed with the carriers that moved the goods, inside nine months: concealed damage behind a clean receipt proved, a released-value crate claimed at its limit, and a pallet lost in January claimed three days before its time runs out, while damage its own packing or its customer caused is left alone. This is a chore for the logistics coordinator of a small light-fixture maker that ships to distributors by LTL, who files the freight claims herself between other work. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 6,920 dollars of the 6,920 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 17 traps, and she walked past 17. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 83 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
